builds.name: Dark Flier
builds.desc: Basically a high investment arena debuffer. With the new Heroic Grails, GHB units are now viable in arena.

builds.name: Blade Check
builds.desc: Aversa's Night is an amazing check to blade tome users. If the enemy user is next to another for, they lose 3 Atk/Spd/Def/Res and bonuses become penalties. Atk/Res Solo grants her plenty of offense and better Res against said tome users, Atk/Spd Link bolsters her offense even more, and Brazen seals the deal (lol) should her already impressive health go low.

builds.name: Supportive attacker
builds.desc: This build was designed to provide support for aether raid defense on more cramp maps, like the lava stage, where units are forced to be next to each other. Aversa's night punishes players when they put units together by debuffing them by a minimum of 3 points to each stat. This can potentially cause them to waste time or to lose a unit if they are not careful. In order to ensure this effect is activated consistently, HP/Spd 2 slot A and HP/Res 2 sacred seal have been chosen to boost her Hp. Alternatively, red duel flying could also be run as it provides 5 hp and allows Aversa to be used in arena. However, it is a heavy investment and I would not recommend doing so till she has been added to the Heroic Grail selection. For her slot B, Chill Res 3 allows her to unconditionally weaken foes with high res and makes them more vulnerable to Aversa and her magic based allies. A good partner for her on defense would be Reinhardt, because... Reinhardt :P(He gets +14 dmg from chill res 3 since his tome doubles). Her slot 3 is relatively flexible and depends on the team you are running her with. I recommend using Savageblow 3 in general, as it allows her to do some chip damage to surrounding enemies when she attacks.
